# Abstract
Paper-b uses in situ infrared spectroscopy to study catalytic mechanisms.

## Methods
The method combines in situ infrared tracking with temperature comparison.

## Results
The mechanism centers on oxygen vacancy sites and reports turnover frequency at 120 C.

## Limitations
The evidence is limited to short-duration runs.
